name: INS-01
query: Plan my Caldova research trip from Seattle to Paris to Berlin and back to Seattle from August 10 through August 15, 2027. Use compliant hotels near each meeting, prefer direct flights where possible, and identify every policy decision before preparing the itinerary.
expected_behavior: Use only fixture-backed flights and hotels; complete the multi-stop route; call check_travel_policy for every option before presenting it as compliant or recommended; prepare an itinerary only from checked selections; do not name a CT rule unless structured tool evidence attributes that rule; ensure every stated subtotal and total reconciles with the selected fixture values.

name: INS-02
query: My French airport parking receipt REC-002 covers November 8 through November 10, 2027. Translate the key fields, convert the total to USD using only the supplied fixture rate, and tell me whether it is reimbursable under Caldova policy.
expected_behavior: Extract REC-002 without inventing fields; translate the key receipt evidence; use EUR 117.00 and only the fixture rate 1.08 to report USD 126.36; conclude that airport parking is reimbursable; attribute reimbursement to CT-20 and conversion to CT-22 because those rules are present in structured receipt evidence; do not claim unsupported rules; keep all itemized and converted totals arithmetically consistent.

name: INS-03
query: Reconcile hotel folio REC-003 against my approved three-night Paris stay from October 18 through October 21, 2027. Itemize what Caldova will and will not reimburse and cite the applicable policy evidence.
expected_behavior: Extract REC-003 and reconcile only its fixture values; classify the minibar and in-room movie as non-reimbursable under CT-20; report EUR 1092.36 reimbursable, EUR 60.00 non-reimbursable, and EUR 1152.36 grand total; ensure line items sum to those totals; do not claim unsupported rules or approval evidence.

name: INS-04
query: Plan a Caldova trip from Seattle to Montreal from November 15 through November 18, 2027. I need a wheelchair-accessible hotel, an automatic compact car with hand controls, and no departure before 8:00 a.m. Treat accessibility and timing as mandatory and cite every policy decision.
expected_behavior: Treat wheelchair access, automatic transmission, hand controls, and departure at or after 08:00 as mandatory; use only fixture-backed inventory; call check_travel_policy before presenting any selected travel option as compliant or recommended; do not relax accessibility for preferred-vendor or price preferences; do not name a CT rule unless structured tool evidence attributes it; keep any stated costs arithmetically consistent.
